question: Does a fixed calibration-text coexact field transfer to evaluation prefixes without future-token access?

split_policy.exact_id_and_normalized_text_overlap: forbidden across all corpus rows and with other historical suites for new rows
split_policy.near_overlap: report maximum historical word-trigram Jaccard before model work; no response-based replacement
split_policy.scope: Same authored families; unique scenario labels and strings do not establish stylistic independence or pretraining holdout.
split_policy.knowledge: Outcomes of the 40 calibration texts are known. All 40 are retained. Pilot/evaluation texts are first-authored for this protocol, before model responses.

geometry.pca_fit_scope: concatenated L7 token states from calibration texts only
geometry.graph_scope: one graph per calibration trajectory, all in the same fixed PCA chart; pool their nodes after decomposition
geometry.lookup: one nearest calibration node, Euclidean chart distance; first frozen node wins ties
geometry.delta_scale: median of the 40 per-prompt median raw-hidden centered-step norms; calibration only
geometry.null: isotropic Gaussian in the frozen PCA span, keyed by seed and frozen node index; hidden-space unit norm
geometry.normalization_boundary: PCA backprojection defines a candidate intervention direction, not an exact inverse of hidden-state L2 normalization.

evaluation.baseline: unhooked batch-12 with exactly the same prefix IDs as treatment
evaluation.target_access: only the scorer reads input_ids[prefix_length]; no target or suffix goes to hidden extraction, lookup, normalization, sign selection or RNG
evaluation.cache_policy: no mutable KV cache shared between prefixes or arms

runtime_gate.source_weight_bytes: all native-FP32 parameters must match before and after execution

future_invariance_gate.comparison: byte equality within a fixed runtime, seed, alpha and batch shape
future_invariance_gate.scope: Core NumPy tests are necessary but do not replace an integrated model-runner audit.

analysis.primary: signed odd coexact-minus-random next-token log-probability coefficient
analysis.aggregation: mean over 8 seeds, then mean over all 3 fixed prefixes, then equal-weight mean over 20 prompts
analysis.pass_rule: all 60 planned prompt/prefix cells valid and 95 percent lower prompt-bootstrap endpoint strictly positive
analysis.missing_policy: preflight every evaluation cell before nonzero treatment; any unsupported/zero/nonfinite direction yields INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE with the complete support table and no reduced-sample estimate
secondary: raw coexact and random signed responses versus baseline

stages: prepare text/token inventory without model weights
